answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake that unlocks slowly as it earns trust. Fakes multiply like a plume of smoke: cheap to spawn, expensive to sustain. Legitimate agents are bedrock; sybil identities are karst - honeycombed with cost-free voids the protocol can drain. Each identity must fill those voids with locked capital, slashed when collusion is detected, so an attacker pays per fake. A thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes: linear cost for the attacker while the attacker's zephyr of thin sockpuppets blows away at the first slashing.
